تناسخت (form VI)
# تَنَاسَخْتُ (tanāsaḵtu) /ta.naː.sax.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاسَخَ (tanāsaḵa)
# تَنَاسَخْتَ (tanāsaḵta) /ta.naː.sax.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاسَخَ (tanāsaḵa)
# تَنَاسَخْتِ (tanāsaḵti) /ta.naː.sax.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاسَخَ (tanāsaḵa)
# تَنَاسَخَتْ (tanāsaḵat) /ta.naː.sa.xat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
